name: Gipsy Nightclub

sources.observed: Contractor completed-2023 album. Original street facade and courtyard photos inspected; room layout study ongoing.
South street facade: five tall canopy bays and arched end windows, tan panel finish, gold sign and parapet railing.
East courtyard: rollup entrance, lowered central cornice, tall side piers, sign, planted terrace and outdoor tables.
Public room: long bar, red rounded chair backs, lattice columns with purple leaf capitals, circular truss and seating.
Reverse bar angle shows courtyard glazing to one side; room connection corroborated but partition distances inferred.
Bar apron lattice, footrail, bottle shelf, pendants and mottled wall finish.

Current aerial visually inspected: main rectangle north of Naples, east garden courtyard toward Paradise. Mapped shell fits main extent; small southern notches replaced with photographed continuous facade. Imagery acquisition date unspecified.

Walkable furnished courtyard, fine original shrub/tree/palm geometry, and public bar room with red oval-back stools, bar lattice, bottle shelves, decorative columns, pendants and circular truss.
